LatticeTests production proof requires every actual frontend object and concrete module/doc/source-info output exactly once, rejects duplicates/unexpected/missing targets, requires every authenticated Swift source plus the exact module map in every rule, and rehashes dependency copies, listed inputs and targets. Unused output-map global/partial-module slots receive no credit.

The exact module map and sealed shim/header postimages form a separately labelled inference. Actual selected driver and object-producing frontend must select the map, define the profile macro, include the Core root and use the same canonical owned ModuleCache. Runner freshness checks create the one-shot scratch empty before resolve/build.

VFS overlays, prebuilt module/PCH selection, forwarded preprocessor/cache and alternate prefix/header lookup overrides are refused. Ordinary Swift and Clang include roots receive directory and conflicting-header checks.

Base compiler proof is saved and hash-bound before supplemental proof construction. A failed supplement still allows verification of available base evidence, explicitly reports profile proof absent, and preserves the primary failure while independent final checks continue.
